summary:
WE need you, for this space mission!

Welcome onboard player, you’re going to explore many different distant planets and create the perfect ship.

Discover the origins of space while flight academy teaches you!

This project is about making a game in the study field about exploring a planet that's very far away from earth! 

Where the player has the role to create a rocket to observe around given planets such as LHS 1140 b which is 40.7 light years away from earth , L 98-59 d which is 34.6 light years away from the earth and etc by using einstein ring to observe.

WAIT! Before you could actually go out and discover planets you’ll need a vessel first! Which is the rocket! 

The rocket is created by combining parts of the rocket together such as the main core, left booster, right booster and more whatever you want just to make sure it's viable! One big enemy is your budget, don't forget that!

For space nerds or all people overall, there are buttons of accurate stats for all of you. We know you… 😉

After completing all recent steps, players have to launch the rocket to orbit around the target planet and the game will calculate the score out into grade for how suitable the rocket is to use to observe the planet.

Choose your planet, Accept briefs, build rockets, and more!

Goodluck commander, I know your efforts will be of use to us!
details: What it does and how it works: Mirage Horizon is a browser-based game where players design and fly a simulated mission to the Solar Gravitational Lens, far beyond the planets. Players choose an exoplanet, build a rocket, launch it, conduct an experiment, transmit data and review their results. Benefits and intended impact: The game makes complex space-mission design more accessible. It helps players understand how decisions about mass, power, propulsion and budget affect a mission, while encouraging interest in space science and engineering. Tools and technology: The project uses JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, Vite and GitHub Pages. It runs in a web browser on a computer; no specialized hardware is required. An OpenWork AI and google antigravity assistant helped with redesign, deployment,documentation and game's source code. Creativity: Mirage Horizon combines storytelling, rocket assembly, flight simulation and a fictional exoplanet-imaging experiment into one interactive mission. Factors considered: The design considers scientific objectives, spacecraft mass, thrust, fuel, power, cost, communications and mission risks. It references NASA Exoplanet Archive data, while its images, mission outcomes and biosignatures are simulated—not real observations.
